limitations: One original complete pair of long trousers. Both legs form one garment; no color, fit or fabric variants counted. Geometry was authored afresh, not extracted from any survival suit or earlier outfit.
Own approximate dimensions, about 1.03 m long. Front reference silhouette informs waist, crotch, legs, closure and cuffs; exact measurements, tailoring and fit are not reproduced.
Waist and both cuffs are genuine open boundaries of the hollow garment. The cloth is a closed solid shell with authored 4 mm thickness for static visualization, not measured textile thickness.

Rear surfaces and hidden construction are generic. Pocket and fly details are raised decorative seam lines over the cloth, not functional pockets or an operating zipper. No hidden rear-pocket pattern is claimed observed.
No body, mannequin, rig, cloth simulation or wearable fit provided. No operation, safety or Unity certification.
Private source is a published BOSS stimulus with original photographer/maker unverified. No source photograph, brand, logo or photo texture is included.
UVs are valid overlapping per-face planar projections, not a unique packed bake atlas. Original plain material colors require no external textures.
Unlabelled actual full-size and 128px renders were reviewed as recognizable trousers. This is an assistant visual judgment, not a player audience test.
